name: Robe of Eyes
summary: A robe that grants all-around vision, Darkvision, and Truesight, but bright light can blind you.

stats.effect:
This robe is adorned with eyelike patterns. While you wear the robe, you gain the following benefits:

***All-Around Vision.*** The robe gives you Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

***Special Senses.*** You have Darkvision and Truesight, both with a range of 120 feet.

***Drawbacks.*** A *{ref:spell/light}* spell cast on the robe or a *{ref:spell/daylight}* spell cast within 5 feet of the robe gives you the Blinded condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of your turns, you make a Constitution saving throw (DC 11 for *{ref:spell/light}* or DC 15 for *{ref:spell/daylight}*), ending the condition on yourself on a success.
